# DateTimeConstantsUsage

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `DateTimeConstantsUsageInspection`

The `ISO8601` date format constants do not actually produce ISO-8601 output
(the offset lacks a colon). The `ATOM` variants produce the compliant format
and should be used instead.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{8,9,10,11,12} [Before]
<?php
class Stamp { const ISO8601 = 'Y'; }
class LocalTime extends DateTime {}

function formats(DateTimeImmutable $at)
{
    return [
        DATE_ISO8601,
        \DATE_ISO8601,
        DateTime::ISO8601,
        DateTimeInterface::ISO8601,
        LocalTime::ISO8601,
        Stamp::ISO8601,
        DATE_ISO8601_LEGACY,
        DATE_RFC3339,
        $at->format('c'),
    ];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Stamp { const ISO8601 = 'Y'; }
class LocalTime extends DateTime {}

function formats(DateTimeImmutable $at)
{
    return [
        DATE_ATOM,
        \DATE_ATOM,
        DateTime::ATOM,
        DateTimeInterface::ATOM,
        LocalTime::ATOM,
        Stamp::ISO8601,
        DATE_ISO8601_LEGACY,
        DATE_RFC3339,
        $at->format('c'),
    ];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 8: DATE_ISO8601 is not ISO-8601 compliant; use DATE_ATOM.</li>
<li>line 9: DATE_ISO8601 is not ISO-8601 compliant; use DATE_ATOM.</li>
<li>line 10: ISO8601 is not ISO-8601 compliant; use the ATOM constant.</li>
<li>line 11: ISO8601 is not ISO-8601 compliant; use the ATOM constant.</li>
<li>line 12: ISO8601 is not ISO-8601 compliant; use the ATOM constant.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DateTimeConstantsUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DateTimeConstantsUsage

/**
 * @noinspection DateTimeConstantsUsageInspection
 */
```
